name: 6502.pdf
description: A comprehensive January 2021 compilation published by Turkey's Ministry of Commerce containing the full text of Consumer Protection Law No. 6502 together with all its associated secondary legislation, including regulations on unfair contract terms, installment sales, consumer credit, housing finance, distance and off-premises contracts, timeshare and package travel, warranty and after-sales services, commercial advertising, consumer arbitration boards, refurbished product sales, and 2021 administrative fine schedules.
